parsed.name: SQLite CAN消息记录器
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于将接收到的CAN总线消息缓冲后异步写入SQLite数据库，并在需要时从数据库中读取历史消息，适合实验中的总线数据记录、追溯与离线分析。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that buffers received CAN bus messages and writes them asynchronously to an SQLite database, and can also read back recorded messages for experiment data logging, traceability, and offline analysis.

actions.description: 停止记录并将缓冲区中剩余的CAN消息全部写入SQLite数据库。
actions.description_en: Stop logging and flush all remaining buffered CAN messages to the SQLite database.
